thesis: AppLovin has an evidence-supported operating-value purchase at 21.68x trailing earnings: revenue grew 53%, continuing profit 64%, and quarterly FCF reached $863.3m. The bull decisively answers cash and financing fragility with only $461.766m net debt; imperfect cash conversion does not erase substantial absolute cash. Platform concentration, exceptional margins and the severe chart decline restrict conviction and entry aggressiveness.
strongest_counterexample: At 77.68% operating margin, platform economics are unusually consequential; $2.171bn receivables and only 68.16% FCF-to-continuing-income conversion leave earnings vulnerable to weaker collection or margin durability.
invalidation_conditions: In a comparable quarter, FCF-to-continuing-income conversion below the observed 68.16% while receivables exceed $2.171bn would undermine the cash-supported purchase.
Year-on-year continuing operating-income decline in two consecutive reported quarters would invalidate the current growth-led thesis.
decisive_factors: Actual FCF is substantial relative to net debt; 21.68x trailing valuation supplies a basis independent of 13.29x forecast earnings.
No verified impairment in this envelope converts the selloff into proof of business failure.
